scope: Vertical refinement in a 16 m by 1.6 m inlet-region domain. Horizontal spacing is 4 m. The top boundary differs from the larger-domain study.

grid_runs.model: 2D conditional open-boundary Euler-HLLC/Fourier/gravity with equilibrium UV EOS; EEC550 vertical slice

configuration.boundary: ambient inflow; extrapolating right/top outflow with reservoir backflow; reflecting adiabatic ground

limitations: Fixed isothermal reference well balancing; no universal hydrostatic equilibrium preservation.
Common equilibrium velocity/temperature; no slip, phase rates, viscosity or turbulence.
First-order reference-corrected HLLC; strong shocks and arbitrary moving contacts unvalidated.
2D plane-source approximation; finite-width/crosswind dispersion is absent.
Prescribed source flux and reservoir inflow can reflect acoustic waves.
Right/top zero-gradient outflow with ambient backflow is not proven nonreflecting.
Inlet log wind is prescribed; inviscid ground has no rough-wall stress or turbulence closure.
Short transient numerical test, not a developed EEC550 150-second comparison.
No terrain, ground heat transfer or cross-plane receptor validation.
Source overlap flux is exact but subcell source structure/potential distribution is unresolved.

provenance.source_hash_basis: UTF-8 text normalized to LF for Git/platform reproducibility

source_thermodynamic_compatibility.meaning: Recorded source matches live TP closure and caloric reference; no arbitrary reference remapping is inferred.

atmospheric.backflow_state_basis: Canonical adjacent ambient cell; reference correction maps the hydrostatic face pressure. Near-zero normal velocity uses a 1e-8 m/s switching deadband.
atmospheric.pressure_boundary: Extrapolated right/top outflow; ambient reservoir on backflow. Not nonreflecting.
atmospheric.ambient_cell_quadrature: rho cell mean times log-wind cell mean; kinetic energy of mean velocity, not exact density-weighted shear quadrature
atmospheric.source_energy_potential_basis: Exact overlap-centroid height, not cell-centre height
atmospheric.source_flux_meaning: Gross prescribed patch flux includes normal pressure traction; excess subtracts the ambient portion it replaces.

source.pressure_datum_note: H00 stays at 102500 Pa; assigning ambient 102500 Pa at ground creates a small positive source pressure excess. This is an explicit datum assumption, not measured thrust.
source.geometry_evidence: Centre height 0.5 m, top-hat profile and aspect ratio are assumptions; area/width/height are H00 flow-consistent calculations.

atmosphere.pressure_datum_evidence: Ground datum assumed; original database pressure measurement height is unknown.
atmosphere.humidity_definition: Relative to the adopted normalized liquid-water saturation closure; original source-feed water convention remains unchanged.
atmosphere.wind_direction_datum_note: Raw selected wind-from 197.73 degrees is treated in the common local magnetic-north frame for this projection. Its independent compass datum was not recovered; no declination correction is applied.
atmosphere.stability: assumed neutral; not simultaneous enforcement of estimated L=-90 m

plane.axes: x along original 30-degree jet; z up; cross-plane axis clockwise from x
plane.origin: equivalent source window centre projected to ground; computational x=0 at window
plane.meaning: 2D infinite-slab approximation normalized per metre of depth. The finite source width only converts nominal kg/s to kg/(m s); finite-width side entrainment and omitted crosswind are not represented.

numerics.conductivity_evidence: Zero explicit conduction for atmospheric smoke; positive overrides are synthetic numerical coefficients, not measured industrial transport.

boundaries.left: prescribed source flux on exact patch overlap; neutral ambient inflow outside
boundaries.right: open outflow treatment with declared backflow state
boundaries.top: open treatment with declared ambient backflow state

original_reported_equivalent_source.meaning: Reported rounded equivalent-source record preserved separately; H00 is not a measured correction.

comparison_policy.policy: Future developed unfenced plume comparison, not a fresh 150-second pulse. Current short 2D smoke is not this comparison.
comparison_policy.receptors: 30 original 3D sensor positions are not reduced or fitted to this 2D plane.

limitations: No finite-width crosswind dispersion; projected weather does not recover oblique 3D flow.
No turbulence closure or maintained turbulent atmospheric boundary layer.
Short domain/time and coarse smoke grid do not resolve EEC550 concentration footprints.
Source composition, position and time assumptions remain unresolved historically.
Open boundary reflections and backflow behaviour require numerical checks; no nonreflecting claim.
No terrain, operational safety or Adoshi reconstruction claim.
